text: 2.3 Hello Louise. Oh Sarah, alright. How's it going? Okay, I'm a bit stressed to be honest. I'm working quite hard at the moment. We're finishing at nine most days. Really? Oh, what a pain. You must be exhausted. Yeah, I am. So what are you doing here? Are you window shopping? What? No, no, not really. I'm just meeting a friend here. I'm a bit early. Oh, right. Hey, listen, Sarah. I've wrong you a few times recently, but you always seem to have your phone switched off or you don't answer it. Oh, right, yeah. Sorry about that. So why aren't you answering it? Don't you want to talk to me? No, no, it's not that. I mean, you usually answer it on the first ring. I know, I know. So what? Is it work? Sort of. What do you mean sort of? Well, if you must know, I'm seeing someone from work. Oh right. But why are you being so mysterious about it? It's unlike you. You normally tell me everything. Well, it's just...well it's my boss. You're going out with your boss. So how long has this been happening? About three weeks. That's not long. No. That's why I don't want anyone to know for the moment. I've just changed jobs too. Oh really? I didn't know that. What are you doing now? Did you get promoted? No. The new job isn't really a promotion. I'm not getting any more money. I'm just doing something different. It's more marketing than sales. And you studied marketing, didn't you? Yeah, that's right. I prefer marketing, so it's a good change. I'm really enjoying it. Well, with your boss, it sounds like you're having a great time. But I didn't get the new job because of my boss. I was promoted by head office. Oh, right. But you see, this is why I don't want people to know about the relationship. They'll think I've got the job because I'm going out with the boss. It's really annoying. Okay, okay, I'm sorry. It was a stupid thing to say. Listen, what are you doing on Friday? Do you fancy meeting? It'd be nice to hear more of your news. I'm afraid I can't. I play badminton on Fridays.
